governance.validation_note: Reproducible via scripts/probes/_miso53_som_coal_offers.py main (solved at 89c9c01, clean tree). Rule-20 zero-forcing ablation twin: same script, ablation mode. The tranche-share question the task raised is resolved by dimension: the SOM self-commit share is a share of STARTS and cannot size capacity tranches; the CAMPD all-hours per-plant floor (mustrun_pct ~= Pmin x fraction-of-year-held-online) already IS the realized per-plant self-commitment floor, so it remains the sizing input and the SOM share corroborates the mechanism fleet-wide (docs/handoffs/miso-coal-offer-som-redesign-2026-07.md §3).
governance.residuals_note: DISCOVERED RESULT — the coal over-run's root cause is CONFIRMED as the below-cost offer surface. With every coal tranche above must-run at measured delivered SRMC: C4 dispatch-corr passes ALL SIX cells (coal r 0.925/0.930/0.900, gas 0.925/0.893/0.919 — the miso-50/51/52 C4-2024 FAIL is gone: near-cost coal load-follows like real coal); C5a CO2 passes all years (+0.6/-3.3/+4.3% vs miso-50's +13.1/+10.8% FAILs); CC_REGULAR returns to band (+3.96/+1.86 TWh vs -11.2/-17.3); COAL_PRB 2024 lands at -0.53 TWh (was +25.1), 2023 +11.45 (was +29.9); coal family 2025 +14.6% (was +23.6%), gas -12.4% (was -19.5%). C1 all 11/16, free 7/12 (miso-52: 9/16, 5/12). Removing the compensating discount UNMASKS two pre-documented gaps (rule 11): (a) CT_PEAKER over-run +16.9/+24.6 TWh — the de-leaked neutral-1.0 MISO CT committed hurdle, whose own de-leak comment predicted 'expect CT over-run'; the deep-discounted coal had been absorbing that energy; the MISO-grounded CAMPD CT hurdle/econ ramp is the queued lane. (b) mean-LMP now OVERSHOOTS 2023/24 (+24.2%/+13.4%; 2025 -5.0% PASS) with monthly NRMSE 0.311/0.304 (2025 0.102 PASS) — the marginal setter lands on CT/coal-econ_high bands ABOVE the measured coal-SRMC anchor (actual RT mean ~= coal base SRMC), where it used to land below it; the >=1.0 rising bands kept from the legacy residual surface are now the binding marginal-region question for the sanctioned rule-1 offer-curve step. COAL_BIT over-corrects low (-8.5/-11.5 TWh — full-cost BIT loses mid-merit to the unhurdled CTs, same interaction). C3c: 2024 PASSES (13h, 0.54x DA); 2023 33h vs 1h DA is the DA-representation gap (RT companion 30h, near-exact); 2025 0.29x remains the RDC/ELMP scarcity-tail lane.
